metadata.title: MAPP 4516.1 Rev. 2 Criteria for Developing and Publishing Digital Content on the CDER External Web Site
metadata.legal_basis: CDER Manual of Policies and Procedures (internal FDA review procedure). Informative; not binding on applicants.
metadata.applicability: FDA staff procedure. Category: Public Outreach.

candidates.statement: BACKGROUND This MAPP outlines the criteria that must be met when developing and publishing content on the Drugs website.

 Coordinating and obtaining internal clearance and publishing approval from senior management. In some cases, approval must be obtained through the CDER Director of Regulatory Policy, FDA regulatory counsel, and HHS Web staff.
candidates.context:  Assuring the accuracy, currency, and quality of information.  Complying with section 508 to provide accessible information.  Reviewing the information at least every two years for currency and accuracy.

candidates.statement: Writing of web content Website content is accurate and concise. It will reflect current science and Agency policies. All material written for FDA.gov must be in plain language according to the Plain Writing Act of 2010, and at a reading level or comprehension level appropriate for its specific audience. Content published on the Drugs website will follow FDA Website Style Guide.
candidates.context:  Webinar content is developed and cleared in the originating office or division. Effective Date: 12/26/12; 03/11/20 ; 7/21/25 Page 5 of 10

candidates.statement: 2. Does the content creator need to have content cleared at a higher level? a. Yes i. Sends to content approver to make sure it’s accurate and can be disclosed to the public.
candidates.context: 1. Web content creator produces content. ii. Web content approver clears the content and returns to content creator.
